# Color Sets

```{r}
color_SampleType <- hue_pal()(17)

# using " unique(S_metadata$FruitType)" 
color_FruitType <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4", "ST" = "red2")

# using cold colors for batch 1 sites, warm for batch 2
color_FruitSite <- c("na" ="grey", "FIN" = "skyblue", "IST" = "blue2" ,  "LOM" = "skyblue4", "MIL" = "deepskyblue", "VAR" = "dodgerblue", "THU" = "coral2")

color_FruitVariety <- c("CDP" = "indianred", "HED" ="indianred1", "SUM" = "indianred4", "STA"="#CD2626", "SWE" = "firebrick1", "CIF" = "gold", "CIR" = "gold2", "DRE" = "lightgoldenrod1", "INF" = "yellow2", "MDB" = "yellow", "UNK" = "skyblue", "LOC"= "deepskyblue")

color_FruitSiteTypeVariety <- c("THU_BL_LOC" = "deepskyblue","THU_BL_UNK"="skyblue", "VAR_BL_LOC" = "dodgerblue", "THU_CH_HED"="indianred1", "THU_CH_SWE"= "firebrick1", "THU_ST_CIR"= "gold2", "THU_ST_MDB"= "yellow", "FIN_CH_CDP"= "indianred", "FIN_CH_SUM"="indianred4","LOM_CH_CDP"= "firebrick3", "LOM_CH_STA"="#CD2626","IST_ST_CIF"= "gold","IST_ST_DRE"= "lightgoldenrod3", "MIL_ST_INF"= "yellow2", "MIL_ST_MDB"= "khaki1")

color_LifeStage <- c("na" ="grey",  "Mothers_2days" = "darkolivegreen4", "Larva"= "darkolivegreen2", "Pupa" = "darkorange2", "PupalCase"="#8B4500", "Daughter" ="goldenrod2")

color_Pop <- c("na" = "grey", "CEC"="#C1FFC1", "FRA" = "seagreen3" )

color_Expe <- c("na" ="grey","Fruits_0days" = "red3", "Mothers_0days"="darkolivegreen", "Mothers_2days" = "darkolivegreen3", "Fruits_5_6days" = "red4", "Larvae"= "green3", "Pupae" = "darkorange2", "PupalCases"="#8B4500", "Daughters" ="goldenrod2")

```

# Load data

```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM1&2_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
```

# I. Alpha diversity

## 1. Index calculation
```{r}
# 16S
AlphaDiv_16S <- estimate_richness(ps_rare_16S)

metadata_AlphaDiv_16S <- data.frame(AlphaDiv_16S, sample_data(ps_rare_16S), check.names=TRUE)
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S <- metadata_AlphaDiv_16S %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ObservedRichness = Observed)

df_AlphaDiv_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(AlphaDiv_16S))

# ITS
AlphaDiv_ITS <- estimate_richness(ps_rare_ITS)

metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS <- data.frame(AlphaDiv_ITS, sample_data(ps_rare_ITS), check.names=TRUE)
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS <- metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ObservedRichness = Observed)

df_AlphaDiv_ITS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(AlphaDiv_ITS))
```

## 2. Fruits
### Subset data
```{r}
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

df_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly)


metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

df_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly)
```

### Plots
#### Fruit Type
```{r}
## Bacterial Alpha div
Sha_Fruit_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly, "FruitType",  c("BL","CH","ST"), "Shannon" ,color_FruitType) 

ObsRich_Fruit_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly, "FruitType",  c("BL","CH","ST"), "ObservedRichness" ,color_FruitType)

Chao1_Fruit_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly, "FruitType",  c("BL","CH","ST"), "Chao1",color_FruitType)

invSimp_Fruit_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_FruitsOnly, "FruitType",  c("BL","CH","ST"), "InvSimpson",color_FruitType)


## Fungal Alpha div
Sha_F_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly, "FruitType", c("BL","CH","ST"), "Shannon",color_FruitType)

ObsRich_F_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly, "FruitType", c("BL","CH","ST"), "ObservedRichness",color_FruitType)

Chao1_F_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly, "FruitType", c("BL","CH","ST"), "Chao1",color_FruitType)

invSimp_F_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_FruitsOnly, "FruitType", c("BL","CH","ST"), "InvSimpson",color_FruitType)

label_A <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("A. BACTERIA", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))
label_B <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("B. FUNGI", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))

## Figure : combine 16S and ITS plots
F_16S <- (ObsRich_Fruit_16S + Chao1_Fruit_16S + Sha_Fruit_16S + invSimp_Fruit_16S) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect") & theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank())

F_ITS <- (ObsRich_F_ITS + Chao1_F_ITS + Sha_F_ITS + invSimp_F_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x", axis_titles = "collect_x")

# Final plot
F_combined <- (label_A / F_16S / label_B / F_ITS) + plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1)) & theme(legend.position = "none")

title_plot <- "AlphaDiv_Fruits_FruitType.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot), F_combined, base_height = 21/cm(1),base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## 3. Individuals

### Subset data
```{r}

metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
df_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv)

metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
df_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv <- data.frame(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv)
```

### Plots
#### Life Stage
```{r}
## Bacterial Alpha div
Sha_LifeStage_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv, "LifeStage",  c("Mothers_2days" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "Shannon" ,color_LifeStage) 

ObsRich_LifeStage_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mothers_2days" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "ObservedRichness" ,color_LifeStage)

Chao1_LifeStage_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mothers_2days" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "Chao1" ,color_LifeStage)

invSimp_LifeStage_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mothers_2days","Larva","Pupa","PupalCase","Daughter"), "InvSimpson" , color_LifeStage)

## Fungal Alpha div
Sha_LifeStage_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mothers_2days" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "Shannon" ,color_LifeStage)

ObsRich_LifeStage_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mother" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "ObservedRichness" ,color_LifeStage)

Chao1_LifeStage_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mother" , "Larva","Pupa","PupalCase", "Daughter"), "Chao1" ,color_LifeStage)
 
invSimp_LifeStage_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_Indiv, "LifeStage", c("Mother","Larva","Pupa","PupalCase","Daughter"), "InvSimpson" ,color_LifeStage)

## Figure : combine 16S and ITS plots
row1 <- (ObsRich_LifeStage_16S + Chao1_LifeStage_16S + Sha_LifeStage_16S + invSimp_LifeStage_16S) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect") & theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank())

# row2 keeps x-axis text and title
row2 <- (ObsRich_LifeStage_ITS + Chao1_LifeStage_ITS + Sha_LifeStage_ITS + invSimp_LifeStage_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x", axis_titles = "collect_x")

# Final plot
combined <- (label_A / row1 / label_B / row2) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1)) & theme(legend.position = "none")

title_plot <- "AlphaDiv_Indiv_LifeStage.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot),
                 combined, base_height = 21/cm(1),  base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## 4. Individuals + Aunt & Fruits

### Subset data, order levels

```{r}
# Filter data
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites" & SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
# 
# ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType <- factor(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType)

metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType <- metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType <- factor(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_expe$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# Filter data
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe <- filter(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites" & SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType <- factor(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType)

metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType <- metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType <- factor(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_expe$SampleType, levels = desired_order)
```

### Plot
#### SampleType + Fruit Type

# II. Beta diversity
## 1. Fruits 

### Subset data
```{r}
# Subset data
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
```

### Fruit Type x Variety NMDS 
#### a. Qualitative (Jaccard index)
```{r}
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, !(FruitType=="BL" & FruitVariety=="LOC"))
##16S
ordi_nmds_J_16S_Fruits <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress =8.488021e-05

# NMDS by FruitSiteVariety
NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_16S_Fruits) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = FruitSiteTypeVariety, shape = FruitType), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_FruitSiteTypeVariety) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitSiteTypeVariety, color = FruitSiteTypeVariety), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_FruitSiteTypeVariety) + 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Fruit Sampling Site", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none") + annotate("text", x = -3.0, y = 2.8, label = "A. Bacteria", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitSiteTypeVariety <- factor(NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitSiteTypeVariety, levels = c("THU_BL_UNK", "THU_CH_HED", "THU_CH_SWE", "FIN_CH_CDP", "FIN_CH_SUM", "LOM_CH_CDP", "LOM_CH_STA", "THU_ST_CIR", "THU_ST_MDB", "IST_ST_CIF", "IST_ST_DRE", "MIL_ST_INF", "MIL_ST_MDB" )) # reorder 

title_plot <- "NMDS_16S_TM123_FruitType_FruitSiteTypeVariety_OutlierLess.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot),
                 NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1),
                base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

## ITS 
ordi_nmds_J_ITS_Fruits <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress = 0.215778

# plot with ellipses
NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_ITS_Fruits) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = FruitSiteTypeVariety, shape = FruitType), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_FruitSiteTypeVariety) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitSiteTypeVariety, color = FruitSiteTypeVariety), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_FruitSiteTypeVariety) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Fruit Sampling Site", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none") + annotate("text", x = -2.8, y = 2.2, label = "B. Fungi", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitSiteTypeVariety <- factor(NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses$data$FruitSiteTypeVariety, levels = c("THU_BL_LOC" , "THU_BL_UNK", "VAR_BL_LOC", "THU_CH_HED", "THU_CH_SWE", "FIN_CH_CDP", "FIN_CH_SUM", "LOM_CH_CDP", "LOM_CH_STA", "THU_ST_CIR", "THU_ST_MDB", "IST_ST_CIF", "IST_ST_DRE", "MIL_ST_INF", "MIL_ST_MDB" )) # reorder 

title_plot <- "NMDS_ITS_TM123_FruitType_FruitSiteTypeVariety.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_diversities", title_plot), NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
# Combined plot
NMDS_Fruits_combined <- ( NMDS_J_16S_Fruits_Ellipses+theme(legend.position = "none") |NMDS_J_ITS_Fruits_Ellipses+theme(legend.position = "right")) + plot_layout(ncol = 2,  widths = c(1, 1),guides = "collect") 

title_plot <- "NMDS_TM123_Fruits_wSites_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot), NMDS_Fruits_combined, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 34/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## 2. Individuals
### Subset data

```{r}
# subset phyloseq object 
ps_rare_16S_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_rare_ITS_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
``` 

### Life stage NMDS

#### a. Qualitative (Jaccard index)
```{r}

ordi_nmds_J_16S_LifeStage <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_rare_16S_Indiv, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress = 0.1461996 

# reorder LifeStage
desired_order <- c("Mother","Larva","Pupa","PupalCase","Daughter")  
sample_data(ps_rare_16S_Indiv)$LifeStage <- factor(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_Indiv)$LifeStage, levels = desired_order)

# plot with ellipses

  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = LifeStage, shape = FruitType), size = 4) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_LifeStage) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Life Stage", ncol = 1),
```

```{r}
## 16S

# plot with ellipses

  scale_fill_manual(values = color_LifeStage) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = LifeStage, color = LifeStage), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) +
```

## 3. Individuals + Aunt & Fruits

### Subset data, order levels
```{r}
# Filter data
ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# Filter data
ps_ITS_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_ITS_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_ITS_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)
```
### Pop x Sample Type NMDS
#### a. Qualitative (Jaccard index)
``` {r} 
ordi_nmds_J_16S_expe_pop <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_16S_rare_expe, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress = 0.1557752
# plot with ellipses
NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_16S_rare_expe, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_16S_expe_pop) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = SampleType, shape = Pop), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(CEC = 21, FRA = 22, na = 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = SampleType, color = SampleType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Genotype"), 
    color = "none")+ annotate("text", x = -3.7, y = 3.3, label = "A. Bacteria", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

title_plot <- "NMDS_16S_Expe_Pop.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", title_plot), NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

  theme_bw() +

  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = SampleType, color = SampleType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Genotype"),
    color = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = -2.9, y = 1.7, label = "B. Fungi", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")
```

```{r}
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none") 

title_plot <- "NMDS_BC_ITS_Expe_SampleType_EllipseByFruit.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_diversities", title_plot),
                 NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit, base_height = 20/cm(1),
                base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
